selected_passages.text: Helena World Chronicle, LLC has filed a class action antitrust lawsuit against Google and Alphabet in the U.S. District Court in D.C., alleging that Google's AI technologies, including Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard, along with older features like the Knowledge Graph, are siphoning content, readers, and ad revenue from news publishers. - The case follows a recent agreement where Google pays Canadian media $73.5 million annually for content use.
